scope: Frozen v2 protocol secondary initialization diagnostic after completed development run; no new fits or selection.
authorship: Model implementer performed this analysis; not external blind review.
original_protocol_registered_diagnostic: also score the four compact gate models at their fixed initial coefficients without fitting, to separate a useful hand-specified prior from gains learned from data; secondary diagnostic
risk_accounting: Score each refit separately, then equal mean over seed/horizon/market-year. Initialization has one deterministic forecast, verified seed-invariant. Initialization and fitted outputs use identical original-price labels and risk denominators.

identification_limitations.full_vs_readout: Identical count and initial coefficients, different placement with nonzero initial gate: initial functions and initial risks differ. Report each arm's own fixed prior before claiming learning-placement effects.
identification_limitations.constrained_vs_unconstrained: Initial functions identical, but coefficient parameterizations have unequal raw-parameter derivatives and optimizer dynamics; performance difference does not identify sign constraints alone.
identification_limitations.parameters_vs_function: Changes in gamma/delta coexist with changes in rho/base/beta; net initialization-to-fit gains are not gate-only causal attribution.
identification_limitations.training_loss_vs_development_loss: Original validation choices are retained, including epoch0 and budget endpoint; no outcome-informed adjustment is made.

initial_coefficient_derivative_compariso.scope: Analytic chain rule for a nonzero loss gradient with respect to the same effective gamma/delta at initialization. Not a measured 10.5x overall gradient norm, not a 10.5x loss improvement, and AdamW step effects are not inferred by multiplying raw gradients.
